pipeline.name: Marketing AI Engine — Data Pipeline
pipeline.description: End-to-end flow from raw CSV upload through server processing, AI insight generation, and client-side filtering.

nodes.title: User
nodes.description: Selects two CSV exports — one Google Ads report and one Meta Ads report — via the dashboard upload form.

nodes.title: UploadForm
nodes.description: Validates file types, builds a FormData object with both files, and submits via fetch.

nodes.title: page.js
nodes.description: Main dashboard. Holds results state. Sets loading while waiting, then renders child components on success.

nodes.title: POST /api/analyze
nodes.description: Multer middleware writes uploaded files to server/src/uploads/ (gitignored). Route hands req.files to the controller.

nodes.title: analyzeController
nodes.description: Orchestrates the full pipeline: calls cleaners → merge → analytics → AI, then assembles the final JSON response.

stages.name: Data Cleaning
stages.transport: Parsed CSV rows passed to both cleaners in parallel

nodes.title: cleanGoogleAdsData()
nodes.description: Normalises Google Ads CSV column names, casts numeric fields, and stamps every row with a fixed sub_platform.

nodes.title: cleanMetaAdsData()
nodes.description: Normalises Meta Ads CSV fields and maps publisher_platform to the appropriate sub-platform label.

stages.name: Merge & Schema Mapping
stages.transport: Two UnifiedRow[] arrays merged into one

nodes.title: mergeDatasets()
nodes.description: Accepts variadic arrays of UnifiedRow and flattens them into a single dataset.

nodes.title: unifiedSchemaMapper
nodes.description: Enforces a canonical field set across all rows so downstream analytics can safely read every field without platform-specific guards.

stages.name: Analytics Engines
stages.transport: Single normalised dataset → three analytics engines

nodes.title: generateAnalytics()
nodes.description: Primary engine. Computes totals, blended rates, per-platform breakdown, and per-campaign breakdown in one pass.

nodes.title: calculateKPIs()
nodes.description: Legacy KPI aggregator. Returns simple totals only. Superseded by analyticsEngine.js.

nodes.title: generateCampaignBreakdown()
nodes.description: Groups rows by campaign name, computes per-campaign ROAS/CTR/CPC, and assigns a performance status tag.

stages.name: AI Insight Generation
stages.transport: KPI object + merged dataset → AI service

nodes.title: generateAIInsights()
nodes.description: Builds a structured prompt from KPI totals and campaign data, then calls the OpenRouter client. Falls back to hardcoded insights if the API is unavailable.
notes: fallback to hardcoded insights on API failure

nodes.title: openRouterClient
nodes.description: Wraps the OpenRouter REST API. Reads OPENROUTER_API_KEY from server/.env, sends a chat completion request, returns the assistant message text.

nodes.title: OpenRouter → Claude
nodes.description: Generates a multi-section strategic report: executive summary, platform comparison, campaign intelligence, budget waste, risk detection.

stages.name: API Response
stages.transport: JSON response sent back to client

stages.name: Client Rendering
stages.transport: page.js stores response in React state → child components render

nodes.title: KPIcards
nodes.description: Renders the 8 summary metric cards: Total Spend, Revenue, Clicks, Impressions, Conversions, CTR, ROAS, Conversion Rate.

nodes.title: AdvancedCharts
nodes.description: Recharts visualisations: Revenue vs Spend bar, Platform pie, Conversion funnel, CTR vs Conversion scatter, Revenue trend area, Platform radar.

nodes.title: AIInsights
nodes.description: Renders the insights markdown string with headings and bullet points.

stages.name: Interactive Filtering
stages.transport: Client-side only — no extra API call

filter_logic.reset_trigger: useEffect on [results] — resets to 'all' on new upload

filteredKpis_derivation.pattern: IIFE — recomputes on every render, no useMemo
filteredKpis_derivation.rationale: campaignBreakdown is tiny (≤~10 entries), IIFE is sufficient
filteredKpis_derivation.fallback: returns full kpis if no campaigns match the active filters

filter_responsive: Executive Summary (ROAS, conversion rate, best platform)
not_filter_responsive: AIInsights text — regenerating AI per filter change would be expensive
Scatter chart — uses hardcoded sample data
Radar chart — uses hardcoded sample data
Area trend chart — uses hardcoded sample data
